plan_name: T4.5 / T4.6 runs on the P1-2b API (integration 5f315ba): LR-A2, LR-B, LR-C, LR-D, LR-E outline
sources: coordinator instruction 2026-11-10: use the env's own infrastructure-vs-task classification
rule: Nothing in this file is changed after the first run of the run it describes. A failed bound is reported as FAIL; it is never re-scored or re-declared.

process_rules.reason: Warp 1.17 replays a captured hash-grid build with the descriptor of the device HashGrid built last on the host (P1-3a probe); BatchedCuttingMaterial refuses a second live device grid (UNSUPPORTED_MULTIPLE_DEVICE_HASHGRIDS).
process_rules.hashgrid_init_hook: every wp.HashGrid.__init__ recorded with device and creator
process_rules.census_violation_label: INVALID_MULTI_GRID_PROCESS (run preserved, never used as a row)

common.material: seeded_trim rcs_trim_random_sim_v1, tlmpm_v7_2 law 8, K=2, S=8, 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid
common.fidelity: reduced_fidelity (workload A: ideal edge tracking, no robot dynamics, reaction not fed back)
common.evaluation: frozen seeded_trim goal evaluator via VectorCuttingEnv.evaluate (2 frames: reset state and episode end), host, at every episode end
common.free_vram_rule: free VRAM >= own_vram_bound_mib + free_vram_margin_mib before launch (D-07), else wait, then BLOCKED
common.api: P1-2b (VECTOR_API_REVISION p1_2b): info['termination_reason'] termination_reason_v1, VectorEnvInfrastructureError, material input guard (default on), two-frame evaluation (evaluation_stream off)
common.input_guard: env default (MaterialInputGuardConfig(), on) unless a run declares input_guard

drives.replay_canary: step_measured_edge of the WP-17 Native measured trajectory of the env's scene seed (recorded measured edge poses, resolved digits, measured pad boxes)
drives.recorded_command_policy_v1: rl.policies_batched.RecordedCommandPolicyV1 over the WP-17 recorded commands of the env's scene seed (edge_delta_v1 actions through the same batched call)
drives.random_policy_v1: rl.policies_batched.RandomPolicyV1 (arm_probability 0.5, motion_scale 1.0, salt 0x5EED) keyed by (env reset seed, schedule episode index, step)

cadence.episode_end_sample: after gc.collect(), at every batch step where at least one episode ended (after its reset)
sample_fields: live device HashGrids (gc census; episode-end samples only)
supervisor_sample_fields: per-PID VRAM of the child process tree and co-tenants (nvidia-smi compute apps, -q -d PIDS, pmon)
cadence.tracemalloc: off in measured runs; enabled only in a diagnostic rerun if B3 fails

warmup_rule: Warm-up ends at the batch step at which every env has completed its first quota episode and the reset after it (rl.stability.warmup_end_step). Bounds use samples at or after that step only.

bounds.slope_reporting: Theil-Sen slope with Sen's 95 % interval (gate) and OLS slope with t-based 95 % interval (always reported); a flag records when the OLS upper bound exceeds the limit

B0.quantity: own-PID VRAM peak (nvidia-smi, child process tree)

B1.quantity: Warp mempool used current; Torch memory_allocated

B3.quantity: VmRSS at post-gc episode-end samples vs env-steps (N x batch step)
B3.quintile_rule: median(last quintile) - median(second quintile) <= max(quintile_drift_mib, quintile_drift_fraction * median(second quintile))

B5.quantity: partial / full reset latency p50, p95, max per kind

canary_rule.pass: every full-length canary episode ends with final codes bitwise equal to the Native final codes of its seed, the Native labelled count, and evaluator verdict PASS
canary_rule.terminated_canary: a canary episode that ends terminated is a canary FAIL
canary_rule.on_miss: canary check FAIL (possible state leakage across resets), investigated; never re-scored
canary_rule.history: replay through step_measured_edge reproduced the Native final codes in 40/40 earlier episodes (P1-0, M2)

process_classes.INFRA_OOM_HOST: MemoryError / std::bad_alloc / ENOMEM recorded by the child
process_classes.INFRA_OOM_DEVICE: torch OutOfMemoryError, CUDA error 2, CUDA out of memory, Warp allocation failure
process_classes.INFRA_CUDA_ERROR: other CUDA / Warp runtime errors (illegal address, launch failure), also when the stderr of a signalled child shows one
process_classes.INFRA_CRASH_SIGNAL: return code -11 / -6 / -7 (SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGBUS) without CUDA / OOM text
process_classes.INFRA_KILLED: -9 / 137; cause UNVERIFIED unless kernel OOM evidence is readable
process_classes.INFRA_HANG: no ledger activity for max(hang_min_s, hang_factor_median_step x median step); py-spy dump if installed, SIGTERM, SIGKILL after term_grace_s
process_classes.INFRA_INVALID_STATE: non-finite process state not attributed to an env (split termination_reason_v1: a strict-mode invalid env is TASK_STRICT_INVALID_ENV instead)
process_classes.INFRA_UNKNOWN_EXIT: no end record and nothing else matches
process_classes.INFRA_CONTACT_POOL_OVERFLOW: VectorEnvInfrastructureError CONTACT_POOL_OVERFLOW (shared MJWarp contact pool, workload B)

episode_classes.TASK_SUCCESS: full-length episode, frozen evaluator verdict PASS
episode_classes.TASK_FAILURE: full-length episode, frozen evaluator verdict not PASS
episode_classes.TERMINATED: terminated by any terminal termination_reason bit except 64 (task level; evaluator runs for diagnostics; excluded from success denominators)
episode_classes.ENV_INVALID_STATE: split p1_4_v1 only (long_rollout_v1); not produced under termination_reason_v1
episode_classes.TRUNCATED_RUN_END: in flight when the run completed; not evaluated
episode_classes.INFRA_INCOMPLETE: in flight when the process died (supervisor); infrastructure tally only
episode_classes.ENV_INFRASTRUCTURE: terminated with termination_reason bit 64 (env-level infrastructure, isolated; excluded from success denominators)

classification.info_adapter: rl.supervision.step_status: info['termination_reason'] (termination_reason_v1) when present, infra = bit 64; fallback for envs without it: MATERIAL_INVALID derived from info['invalid_reason'] (kept and tested)
classification.split_rule: The env's own classification decides infrastructure vs task: termination_reason bit 64 (INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR) -> ENV_INFRASTRUCTURE (env level, infrastructure tally); every other terminal bit (MATERIAL_INVALID incl. non-finite state, MATERIAL_INPUT_DOMAIN_GUARD, RIGID_INVALID, GRASP_LOST, IK_FAILURE_STREAK) -> TERMINATED (task level; material detail in invalid_names, numerical_invalid_reasons reported as a sub-tally only). Process: the child records classify_exception(error); VectorEnvInfrastructureError kinds OOM / CUDA_ERROR / WARP_ERROR / CONTACT_POOL_OVERFLOW map to INFRA_OOM_DEVICE / INFRA_CUDA_ERROR / INFRA_CUDA_ERROR / INFRA_CONTACT_POOL_OVERFLOW; an uncaught strict-mode invalid env is TASK_STRICT_INVALID_ENV (not infrastructure); classify_process_exit is recorded for every exit with an agreement flag.

task_process_classes.TASK_STRICT_INVALID_ENV: uncaught strict-mode InvalidBatchEnvs / Invalid rigid worlds (env's classify_exception category 'task')

recovery.resume: new attempt directory attempt_NNN in the same run directory, resumed_from recorded; the episode schedule continues at the next schedule index of every env; nothing is overwritten

fault_injection.variable: RCS_FAULT_INJECT (child script only, never library code); the supervisor passes it to attempt 1 only
fault_injection.spec: comma-separated kind@batch_step; kinds: exception, memoryerror, cuda_error, cuda_oom, sigsegv, sigabrt, sigkill, hang, disk, strict_invalid, nan_env:E, second_grid, device_oom (GPU only); bad_pose:E (one non-finite measured pose for replay env E: T4.2 re-check), infra_env:E (fake only), reset_leak:E (fake only)
fault_injection.cpu_tests: tests/test_rl_supervision.py with the fake child backend

LR-A2.description: as LR-A with alias_free_v1 particle contacts (P1-3a), P1-2b API

expected.canaries: every full canary episode PASS by canary_rule

acceptance: >= 4 quota episodes for every env and >= 4 full-length episodes for every replay and recorded-command env
B0-B4 PASS on every attempt that reached warm-up

LR-B.description: reset stress: 2 untouched replay canaries; 14 random envs force-reset with probability 0.05 per step (SplitMix64 counter schedule); after every reset the reset envs' per-env checksums of every array the reset kernels write (except seeds) must equal those after the initial full reset
LR-B.canary_rule: at every 100-step Native sample the untouched canaries differ from the Native codes in <= 1 particle (M0 history: 0 or 1 particle at single samples from GPU atomic order); positions reported (descriptive band only)
LR-B.reset_check_rule: 0 checksum mismatches over every reset (bitwise; the reset is a copy)

LR-C.description: rebuild cycle: build -> full reset -> 50 steps -> close()/release(), 10 cycles in one process (one live device grid at a time)

bounds.C1: live device HashGrids: 1 while open, 0 after every close

C2.quantity: Warp mempool current, Torch allocated after close + gc

C3.quantity: own-PID VRAM (nvidia-smi) after close vs cycle

C4.quantity: VmRSS after close + gc vs cycle

bounds.C5: graph captures and device HashGrid inits = cycle count (one per build)
bounds.rationale: a leaked material is about 200 MB per cycle at N=4 (49.5 MB/env); 8 MiB/cycle detects it with a 25x margin

LR-D.description: GPU fault probes under the supervisor (one supervised run per fault, each stopped after max_global_steps; reduced by design)

probes.nan_env:1@20: COMPLETE; env 1 TERMINATED (MATERIAL_INVALID, invalid NONFINITE_STATE); env 0 continues with L2 PASS
probes.bad_pose:0@20: COMPLETE, no crash (T4.2 re-check): env 0 TERMINATED with MATERIAL_INPUT_DOMAIN_GUARD; env 1 continues
probes.device_oom@20: FAILED_INFRA_OOM_DEVICE (torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(0.02) then an 8 GiB allocation; this process only)

LR-E.description: Lab B1 rigid mount (workload B) long run via open_vector_env(backend='isaac_lab_newton', tool_mount='rigid_mount_v1'), .deps/isaaclab-venv, GPU0
LR-E.status: DECLARED_OUTLINE (Lab backend child not implemented in this version; needs a run entry with the Lab options before running)

Native reload_in_place memory probe (8 x 20 steps): host 24.2 MiB/episode, GPU 9.3 MiB/episode (docs/POLICY_READY_API.md).
Native stays NOT POLICY_READY (GPU 52 MiB/episode vs threshold 32, unresolved; docs/PROGRESS.md).
No new Native long rollout in P1-4; batched results never replace these FULL_NATIVE_REFERENCE limitations.
